title.zh: 移民（新加坡签证豁免——IEA 区域合作中心）命令 2025
title.en: Immigration (Exemption from Singapore Visa — IEA Regional Cooperation Centre) Order 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Immigration (Exemption from Singapore Visa — IEA Regional Cooperation Centre) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 6 January 2025.

3.—(1) Subject to sub‑paragraph (2), the Secretary‑General of the OECD and the Executive Director of the IEA are exempt from section 9B(1) of the Act.
(2) The exemption from section 9B(1) of the Act conferred by sub‑paragraph (1) does not apply to the Secretary‑General of the OECD or the Executive Director of the IEA if, in any particular case, the exemption is waived by the OECD.
(3) The exemption under sub‑paragraph (1) does not affect the exemptions under the Immigration (Exemption from Singapore Visa) Order 2026 (G.N. No. S 441/2026).
[S 442/2026 wef 01/07/2026]
